events.text: Dayann Méthalie (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Sunderland 0. Enzo Fernández (Manchester City) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Sunderland 1. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Enzo Le Fée with a through ball.
Goal! Manchester City 2, Sunderland 1. Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Antoine Semenyo.

Goal! Manchester City 2, Sunderland 2. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Thomas Meunier.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Goal! Manchester City 3, Sunderland 2. Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Marc Guéhi following a corner.
First Half ends, Manchester City 3, Sunderland 2.
Second Half begins Manchester City 3, Sunderland 2.
Goal! Manchester City 4, Sunderland 2. Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Manchester City 4, Sunderland 3. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nilson Angulo.
Substitution, Sunderland. Malick Fofana replaces Nilson Angulo.
Substitution, Sunderland. Wilson Isidor replaces Noah Sadiki.
Substitution, Manchester City. Jérémy Doku replaces Iliman Ndiaye.
Substitution, Sunderland. Trai Hume replaces Thomas Meunier.

Goal! Manchester City 5, Sunderland 3. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Josko Gvardiol.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Substitution, Manchester City. Nico O'Reilly replaces Rayan Cherki.
Second Half ends, Manchester City 5, Sunderland 3.
